citations.quote: Associated with poorer prognosis and may attenuate response durability to EGFR‑TKI therapy.
Co‑mutation in TP53 is associated with a higher likelihood of early progression

candidates.description: Presence of the p.R273C missense mutation in the TP53 gene.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the TP53 entry in the genomic findings table and check for the p.R273C protein change.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if NGS reports the TP53 p.R273C mutation; negative if TP53 is wild-type or no such mutation is documented.
candidates.name: TP53 p.R273C mutation
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the effect modification is specific to the p.R273C variant or applicable to all TP53 mutations is not fully clarified, although p.R273C is the only one mentioned.

citations.quote: MET amplification may limit durability of EGFR‑TKI response.
May confer primary or acquired resistance to EGFR TKIs

candidates.description: Increase in MET gene copy number detected via NGS.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Review the genomic findings table for 'MET' and look for 'copy-number gain' or 'amplification'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if NGS reports MET copy-number gain or amplification (e.g., copy number ≥ 6); negative if MET is wild-type or no gain is reported.
candidates.name: MET amplification
candidates.uncertainty: The specific copy number threshold for 'amplification' varies slightly across reports (e.g., mentioned as ≥ 6 in one case), though the binary status of 'gain' is consistent.

limitations: The evidence consists of clinical reports mentioning general associations rather than a dataset of patient outcomes.
The sample size of provided clinical excerpts is small.
The distinction between primary and acquired resistance for MET amplification is mentioned but not quantified.
summary: The evidence identifies several co-occurring genomic alterations in patients with EGFR exon 19-deleted lung adenocarcinoma, specifically noting that TP53 mutations and MET amplification are associated with attenuated response durability or resistance to EGFR-TKI therapy.
